notes.title: V 3.02 Live!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

Dropping in to let you all know that I have uploaded the latest build which includes the following;

- bikini costume
- costume selection buttons in the inventory screen
- minor bug fixes and improvements
- stability tweaks

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/bd01f6f3ec8011d7c2f88a6241b0d9202c899456.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/2ac6b52aa0b993727ab5e5b1a64d8846b60f56e3.png[/img][/url]

Some less positive news:

- Unfortunately after doing everything I could to investigate The freezing/crashing on open issue There does not seem to be a fix as I understand it. This could be totally a limitation on me, but I did my best to find something I could do on my end to solve the problem. At present the ONLY way to fix the issue is here

**If your game is crashing at launch, consider the following fix** (thanks to Josef for figuring this out)
- Go to "General" in the game properties on Steam
- Under "Launch options" type: -force -dx11

If anyone has a better answer dev-side please let me know! 

- The second issue I am sad to give an update on is localization. Due to the nature of this game originally being a quick game jam project, the dialogue/interaction system I built was rather quick and dirty. It works but is not the best. At the time I was not aware of what would be required to add in localization to that system. In order to achieve this the entire system would need to be remade, which would also require what is effectively a complete remake of the game. Every interaction and note. This would take quite a bit of extended dev time and at this point it just isn't viable. 

So how do I intend to rectify this? Well, I have completely rebuilt the dialogue and interaction system for the sequel I am working on. I've included localization ability, and am iterating and polishing already. My plan is to have Pan Pan 2 out for Halloween of this year and if things go well enough I would be open to doing the necessary work to rebuild Pan Pan 1. It just really depends on the future and how things go from there. But at the moment I think the best option is to move on to Pan Pan 2 full time and focus all my strength and energy there to make sure that it is a big step forward. 

I will of course continue to push bug fixes and adjustments when necessary and If I get more feedback or requests for content I will consider it! 

Thank you all for your support, I hope you continue to enjoy Pan Pan and look forward to the next title!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 now live!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! here are the patch notes for v1.03!

- Added in Steam Overlay functionality
- Added Steam Achievements (3!)
- Added the alternate "Jacket" costume
- Adjusted behaviors for Pan Pan and the android AIs
- minor bug fixes, optimizations, and improvements.

Sorry this patch took a while! I needed to learn how to sculpt, retopologize, and improve my understanding of substance painter in order to make sure that the new costume looked good. The other costume (bikini) will come a bit later! 

 You can put the costume on or change back to your security uniform at the lockers placed in the back area right at the start of the game. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/894df8be833c42c3632ab744984f05a9bf8662ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/bc1cad93da50d34cf57fc24cdfa851ff2bc31ab1.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/8bbeb50cf6c2861cb8dc02b6c2b4a919d63ee9f0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/b694febafaa6de6fa7ae7068ae5324ad1d0abf40.png[/img][/url]

When I complete the bikini costume to satisfaction I will also try to add both costumes to the inventory UI so they can be selected at any time instead of needing to run back to the lockers to change. Unfortunately the method in which I made the cutscenes was not quite forward thinking enough to allow for the costume changes to effect them. 

So, with some of the limitations of this game in mind, I've also decide that in order to make Pan Pan part 2 an even better game I will be starting from (mostly) scratch and it will be a separate sequel instead of paid dlc here on steam. I have mostly written the narrative and knocked out the design document over the holidays. I think Pan Pan 2 will add a lot of ideas and gameplay that you will all really love, so please look forward to it!

Thank you all for your continued support! I hope this patch adds another reason for you all to play the game again, or finally pick it up if you haven't yet!

notes.title: Halloween Expansion released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thank you so much for supporting us and playing Good Night Pan Pan! The free content expansion is finally here just in time for Halloween!

I did my best to include as much as possible for this update, but unfortunately I was not able to get additional costumes in yet, but I 100% will be providing the jacket costume for free in a future patch before the holidays. the bikini will likely be patched in sometime in the later future as it requires (and deserves) an updated model that will require some more learning on my end.  Depending on how we handle the paid expansion (as DLC or a sequel) both costumes will be included for free in that release as well, hopefully with an additional costume unique to that content. I tried my best to get it in this patch but time moves much faster than my schedule sometimes haha.

Other than the costume here's what's in the patch

FIXES
- various small bug fixes
- further improved the medicine cabinet interaction for stability on loading

ADDITIONS

- additional set dressing and lighting improvements
- Added a new floor, B2. This floor alone is about half the size of the current map. Which adds lore/narrative elements, NEW interactions, new notes, new items, a puzzle, a revision to locations of items in the original map area, and new scares.
- UV light function for the flashlight, which shows hidden "graffiti" and hints in the map.
- new atmospheric music!
- A new chase theme for Pan Pan!
- collectable "Jahki" key chains.
- Mouse sensitivity slider in options
- motion blur toggle in options

Making this content was a lot of fun and I hope that you all enjoy it as you close out the spooky season! I will finally be taking a vacation to celebrate getting Pan Pan out and all patched up, so I won't be able to address any new bugs or issues until I get back, but I tested pretty thoroughly so I don't anticipate anything game breaking. 

I get back from Hong Kong in early November and will be immediately getting to work on the expansion/sequel, firstly with the costumes. I will likely test out the DLC functions and add the costumes that way (for free) if possible, otherwise I will just add it in as an update asap. The sequel will be an entirely new map and continue the story as well as expand on the background of Carmen and Li-Li.

The next patch will probably come out sometime in late November, and my primary focuses will be the following;

- achievements
- gamepad functionality
- Chinese and japanese localization 
- Linux/steamdeck version
- additional gameplay tweaks and improvements
- bug fixes

Thank you again so much for your support! Please leave a review if you haven't yet, and make sure to share the game around everywhere you can! 

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Patch V 1.01
notes.content:
Thank you for your suppor tand playing Good Night Pan Pan! Thanks to player feedback and input I have prepared a patch that does the following;

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

- New game button in the main menu now erases save data without needing to use the delete save button. (delete save button will remain as a fail safe for any bugs/issues that may arise)
- Fixed an issue where certain doors could trap the player when opening/closing
- Fixed an issue where the pushable cart interaction text could stay on screen indefinitely
- Fixed an issue where the brush would no longer spawn on loading the game.

[u][b]Adjustments, Improvements, and Changes[/b][/u]

- Added a "sparkle" glint to inventory items and notes in the map, removing the blinking glow
- All flavor text interactions are repeatable, save a few which are tied to gameplay events.
- Added more flavor text interactions throughout the mall!
- Offerings and Lit offerings now take 2 inventory slots instead of 6. Further, their effective range covers almost the entire map.
- Removed the glowing outline from Pan Pan (possibly making it a toggle or based on game difficulty in the future)
- Pan Pan is more aggressive and will now run to noises which alert her, offerings, and any hiding spot used.
- Increased Pan Pan's hearing range, field of view, and run speed
- added more set dressing and made some adjustments to lighting
- revise Li Li's walk animation
- Added more animations for Pan Pan, including mouth opening
- added additional scares
- added a ghostly trap to certain areas
- Health drink snow only give 1 "heart" 


I have more updates planned and will be carefully paying attention to feedback and bug reports as I work on the FREE expansion/update coming for Halloween!

notes.title: Good Night Pan Pan is out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146121/c77d4f7772d1e017f040290e2defb60eb221fa62.jpg[/img]

Good Night Pan Pan is out now for windows PCs here on Steam! A one-of-a-kind survival horror/Mascot horror mash up soaked in Hong Kong flavor, Good Night Pan Pan is finally ready to stalk and scare you just in time for Spooky Season!  

Features:

[list]
[*] Tense real-time inventory management
[*] Hiding Spots to evade your pursuer
[*] Sprint and dodge when being chased, but watch your limited stamina!
[*] 29 notes and journals telling a rich and captivating murder mystery
[/list]

Good Night Pan Pan was originally made in 30 days as part of a game jam, but the concept and character was too good to not put an additional 60 days into and release here on steam. That's right, 90 days beginning to end for this small but explosive horror game! We love it so much that we've decided to continue supporting Pan Pan with FREE post launch content based on player feedback, so please do let us know what features, additions, and content you want to see! Some plans we already have are;

- Gamepad support
- Linux, Windows, and Steam Deck release
- Chinese (sim/Tra), Japanese, Korean, and any other language we can handle for localization!
- hard mode
- steam achievements
- Unlockable costumes for the player character Li-Li

We've got many more ideas but want to hear yours first, so don't be shy with feedback, harsh critic, and grand ideas for any future content you'd like to see!

Thank you all for your support, I look forward to reading your comments and reviews!

notes.title: Good Night Pan Pan!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! We hope you are looking forward to Good Night Pan Pan.

This one is a little different for me, since quietly rebooting our studio a bit and moving to Unreal Engine from Unity I wanted to make something releasable to show what I've learned and also learn some new things as we work on our larger main project Death Harvest. It's already been 2 years since Midnight released, and DH is a few years away, so I figured it's necessary to start making and releasing smaller projects!

Good Night Pan Pan was made in 80 days, originally as part of a game jam, then I decided it deserved more love and polish. It's a short (1-2 hour long) Survival Horror/Mascot Horror mixture set in cyberpunk Hong Kong! This time I wanted to pair down everything to the cored idea of avoiding the stalker enemy and solving logic/item puzzles that way I could focus on making that as fun and scary as possible.

As I am 100% in control of all of the code and content, I no longer have to worry about limiting what can/can't be done beyond my own capabilities or post launch additions. So I've decided this time to add content as FREE UPDATES, when I hear what you like, dislike, and want to see. Here are some things I'd like to add in the future. Some of this depends on how the game does initially and long term, and what I am capable of.

- hard mode (what this entails I have no idea yet haha)
- unlockable costumes

I do have some bigger ideas for additions and updates, but you will have to play the game first before we can talk about that!
